name: Instant coffee
description: Brewed coffee dried to granules that dissolve — the household default in much of the world.

histamine.note: Read as coffee. Often robusta-based, so the caffeine end runs high — but caffeine is not what inhibits DAO.

stimulant.note: Caffeine alone, and often robusta, which carries roughly twice the caffeine of arabica.

guna.note: Stimulating, which is the definition of rajasic rather than a judgement on it.
